info.name: Business Messaging API
info.description:
A Postman collection of CM's Business Messaging API.


Official API documentation: https://developers.cm.com/messaging/

item.name: send a message, without worring about multipart or encoding

request.description:
This API enables you to send text messages to mobile phones all around the world in very high volume.
The Messaging Gateway API covers the interface between your application and the CM Platform by means of the HTTP protocol. 
Only bulk (free of charge for the end user) text messages are supported.

item.name: Sending Viber text, media and button

request.description: Please note that sending a message containing only media and a button will be rejected by Viber
Send a plain RCS text message. Falls back to the body content on devices without RCS.
Send an image over RCS. mediaHeight can be small, medium or tall.
Send an RCS rich card that combines a header, body text and up to four suggested replies/actions.
Send a plain text Apple Messages for Business message. `from` is the Business Account ID, `to.number` is the Conversation ID.
Send an Apple Messages for Business list picker so the user can pick from preset options.
Send an Apple Messages for Business OpenUrl suggestion with an inline preview image.
Send a plain text Facebook Messenger message. `from` is the Page ID, `to.number` is the recipient's PSID.
Send a Facebook Messenger message with quick reply buttons.
Send a Facebook Messenger generic template (rich card) with a header, body, image and up to 3 buttons.
Send a plain text Instagram message. `from` is the Instagram Account ID, `to.number` is the recipient's IGSID.
Send an Instagram message with quick reply buttons. Only visible in the Instagram app, not the web client.
Send an Instagram generic template (rich card). The `HUMAN_AGENT` postbackdata triggers the handover protocol if configured.
Send a plain text Google Business Messages message. `from` is the Agent ID, `to.number` is the Conversation ID.
Send a Google Business Messages message with quick reply suggestions (max 13).

item.name: GBM rich card with reply suggestions

request.description: Send a Google Business Messages rich card with media and reply suggestions (max 4 suggestions per card).
Send a plain text LINE message. `from` is your LINE user id, `to.number` is the recipient's user id.
Send an image as a LINE message (max 10 MB, png/jpeg/jpg).
Send a LINE button template rich card with a header, body, image, default tap action and up to four buttons.
Send a plain text Telegram message. `from` is your bot id, `to.number` is the recipient's chat id.
Send a Telegram message with text and an image. Telegram displays them together as one entity, with the text below the image.
Send a Mobile Push message with SMS fallback. `appkey` is the channel account id provided during onboarding.

item.name: Push rich card (CMPush V2 SDK only)

request.description: Send a Mobile Push rich card with media and reply suggestions. Requires the CMPush V2 SDK on the receiving device.

item.name: mo-webhooks
item.description:
Our incoming message webhooks, also known as inbound messages or MO (Mobile Oriented) messages.

Configure your application server as the request URL and send these messages to your server to emulate incoming message from our server

- message keys are case-insensitive
